purpose: Crew operations self-check and synthetic training scenarios; not a clinical instrument or WESAD model inference

research_reference.summary: Separate, verified leave-one-subject-out stress classification research; ECG/EDA features require actual sensor data
research_reference.note: Scenarios are invented training examples; no WESAD participant records or model probabilities are included.

scenarios.title: Pre-EVA readiness
scenarios.description: Before a planned extravehicular activity: check readiness to focus on procedures and safety-critical steps.

actions.high: Flag reduced focus or fatigue during EVA planning; tell the crew lead and request an additional readiness review before proceeding.
actions.moderate: Run a checklist cross-check with the EVA partner and confirm workload distribution.
actions.normal: Continue the normal EVA preparation checklist and team briefing.

scenarios.title: Science operations
scenarios.description: During precision laboratory work: monitor workload, concentration and operational errors.

actions.high: Tell the operations lead before handling time-sensitive experiments; request a second-person verification.
actions.moderate: Add a peer check for high-consequence steps and plan a recovery break between tasks.
actions.normal: Continue the established experiment checklist, including routine peer verification.

scenarios.title: Post-shift recovery
scenarios.description: Following a demanding duty period: review perceived stress, sleep, fatigue and readiness for the next shift.

actions.high: Raise the concern at crew health check and agree on a recovery plan before the next critical assignment.
actions.moderate: Discuss rest opportunities and adjust the upcoming task load with the duty team.
actions.normal: Follow the normal end-of-shift recovery and handover routine.

scenarios.title: Mission contingency
scenarios.description: After an unexpected operational event: check whether crew members need support and whether tasks require reassignment.

actions.high: Notify mission control or the on-duty crew medical officer under the approved contingency protocol, and request help immediately.
actions.moderate: Notify the crew lead, conduct a briefing, and verify roles before resuming demanding tasks.
actions.normal: Resume duties only through the approved contingency checklist and debrief.
